SELECT
    p.product_id,
    'POSITION' AS record_type,

    ip.warehouse_id,
    ip.on_hand,
    ip.reserved,
    ip.available,
    ip.last_updated,

    NULL::varchar AS incoming_id,
    NULL::integer AS incoming_quantity,
    NULL::date AS expected_arrival,
    NULL::varchar AS incoming_status

FROM products p
JOIN inventory_positions ip
    ON ip.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id = $1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    'INCOMING' AS record_type,

    ii.warehouse_id,
    NULL::integer AS on_hand,
    NULL::integer AS reserved,
    NULL::integer AS available,
    NULL::timestamptz AS last_updated,

    ii.incoming_id,
    ii.quantity AS incoming_quantity,
    ii.expected_arrival,
    ii.status AS incoming_status

FROM products p
JOIN incoming_inventory ii
    ON ii.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id = $1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    'PRODUCT_ONLY' AS record_type,

    NULL::varchar AS warehouse_id,
    NULL::integer AS on_hand,
    NULL::integer AS reserved,
    NULL::integer AS available,
    NULL::timestamptz AS last_updated,

    NULL::varchar AS incoming_id,
    NULL::integer AS incoming_quantity,
    NULL::date AS expected_arrival,
    NULL::varchar AS incoming_status

FROM products p
WHERE p.product_id = $1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM inventory_positions ip
      WHERE ip.product_id = p.product_id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM incoming_inventory ii
      WHERE ii.product_id = p.product_id
  )

ORDER BY record_type, warehouse_id, incoming_id;
